about: Modelled as a generic product: base frame with lifting lugs, casing in ten sections with joint strips; mixing box with return spigot on top and fresh-air damper (blades, actuator) on the end; filter and HEPA doors with gauges, coil header plates with flow and return, cooling-coil drain and trap, humidifier and fan doors with windows, steam inlet, fan isolator, outlet spigot and control panel. Hinges, handles and windows on every door.
